title: wkstdpty shared PTY bridge
desc: Shared Windows PTY bridge for interactive CLI status capture. Targets are passed as data; no Codex-specific paths, prompts, or model names are hardcoded.
steps: WHAT: wkstdpty is a shared PTY bridge that launches an arbitrary interactive CLI through ConPTY and captures its TUI output.

CONTRACT: the caller supplies the command line, workdir, timing, and optional keystrokes/capture contract as data; the bridge must not hardcode Codex-only paths, prompts, model names, or status semantics.
DESIGN: family-specific behavior belongs in the caller skill or launcher; the bridge stays generic and reusable for any CLI that needs PTY-driven status capture.
VERIFY: after any bridge change, run the relevant caller-level regression and confirm the captured output matches the caller contract.
